## Brand

Refined design style

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, minimal
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=Playfair Display,
  display=Playfair Display, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400,
  500, 600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#3B82F6, secondary=#8B5CF6, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Carefully curated modern minimal style with serif typography and understated
palettes.
